about: Two compose replies of a real model, kept as samples of the reply shape of the app's compose protocol (lib/llm/protocol.ts) for the live stand-in (live-stand-in.ts). Recorded on 2026-10-09 with LLM_RECORD=1 from the main model of that day (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, retired on 2026-10-16); the cassettes they came from were removed with it. They are not Hunyuan replies.
